# `ext::msgpack` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/msgpack.lani#L7)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Streaming MessagePack: a chunk-fed Decoder (sticky typed errors with u64 offsets, depth/item/payload/input limits, concatenated streams, optional canonical-header and timestamp checks), EventReader over core::io::Read, and a Writer that emits the shortest formats, patches unknown container lengths and flushes its stable prefix to core::io::Write. Native Linux x86_64 binaries agree with the installed Python msgpack package and an independent model on 76 hand-typed format cases, 1,500 generated, 3,000 mutated, 2,398 limit and 1,200 stream cases; the msgpack-json sample agrees on 900. The cargo registrations were not run in this session.
